name: Augustus Daltrey
original_name: オーガスタス＝ダルトリー
source:
"Yo, How are you feeling? I slept late and got yelled at by my wife, anyway we're going to be late to the meeting at this rate, oh, speaking of being late- (etc.)"

The boss of the navy who is adored by his subordinates. 
A sociable and kind person.
He taught [url=/c42787]Frederick[/url] how to use guns.
